characters.prompt:
Create one Korean Hahoe Yangban masked adult performer. Distinctive warm brown carved wooden nobleman mask with arched brows, narrow smiling eyes, prominent nose, smiling cheek ridges, and separate articulated lower jaw seam. Mask fully covers face; do not substitute a realistic human face. Black traditional gat with woven horsehair texture. Adult slender balanced proportions about six heads tall, full-body relaxed upright pose, cream coarse linen durumagi outer robe, muted indigo inner hanbok trousers and sage sash, simple dark traditional shoes. One hand lightly holding a folded bamboo fan beside waist, other resting at side. Quiet dry humor and dignified warmth, subtle asymmetry, no exaggerated dance pose. A performer wearing a mask rather than a disembodied mask.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: independent full-body cutout for Hangul Sori, a mature Korean language-learning app. The attached Haechi and coins are material/light references only. Same restrained Korean Dancheong world: celadon sage green, muted indigo, warm ochre, rust red, ivory. Tactile handmade carved painted sculpture, visible wood grain and irregular pores, coarse woven linen, hand-painted pigment, soft upper-left light, sculpted planes and credible adult anatomy. Transparent background, no scene, no writing, no watermark, whole body uncropped with breathing room. Absolutely no smooth digital plastic, no shiny toy, no jelly, no baby proportions, no big anime eyes. IMPORTANT: match the geometric faceted style, color palette, paper grain texture, and overall mood of the attached reference images exactly. This must look like part of the same illustrated set.

Cream and muted rust coarse linen hanbok vest and deep sage loose trousers, woven straw footwear. One hand resting on a simple carved wooden bangmangi club held upright at the side, other open as if asking a friendly question. A little tuft of subdued blue-green painted spirit detail near club is allowed. No horns, no Japanese oni imagery, no tiger-skin loincloth, no fangs, no scary demon, no child proportions, no huge head.
